newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lebanon's Hariri says Israel behind Syria blast.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Hariri says Israel behind Syria blast.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri, echoing Syrian charges, blamed Israel on Saturday for the bomb blast in Damascus that killed nine people and wounded 44 others on December 31.
Hariri, after meeting French President Jacques Chirac in Paris, told reporters: "Obviously, what happened in Damascus is a crime. Lebanon condemns it...Israel is behind (the blast)."
Israel has denied a Syrian report that Israeli agents planted the bus bomb which exploded on Tuesday. Washington warned Damascus against making "wild and irresponsible" statements without evidence.

"The prime minister (Benjamin Netanyahu) said that the accusations published in Damascus accusing Israel of responsibility for terrorist attacks in Syria are an outright lie. We have no connection to the terrorist attack in Syria and Syria knows it," the Israeli cabinet said in a statement.
Syria is the main foreign power-broker in Lebanon where it has some 35,000 troops. Israel occupies part of south Lebanon.
Ties between Syria and Israel, which have held sporadic peace talks since 1991, deteriorated sharply after Netanyahu took office in June last year.
